descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper noun פִּינְחָס (Pinchas/Phinehas), a personal name borne by at least two individuals in Scripture: the grandson of Aaron who was zealous for God's honor (Numbers 25), and a son of Eli who served as priest at Shiloh (1 Samuel). All four clusters are mere orthographic and syntactic variants of the same name: standalone (eng: Phinehas/Pinchas, spa: Finees/Pinejas, arb: فِينَحَاسُ, kor: 비느하스, swa: Finehasi), with conjunction waw (eng: and Pinchas, spa: y Finees, arb: وَ فِينَحَاس, hin: और पीनहास), and possessive constructions (hin: पीनहास के/का/की). These represent no semantic distinction.
